title: One week to December
headline: One week to December
detail: A calm start before the busy weeks
caption:
Is your diary filling up faster than you can say "mince pie"? 🎄

This is the last full week of November, and the Christmas lights switch-on in Clitheroe is this Saturday. Once December arrives, weeks tend to disappear.

So this week, pencil in an hour just for you.

On the reformer, strength comes from slow, controlled work that suits every body, whatever your age or starting point. You'll leave feeling longer, steadier and a little more ready for the festive rush.

Never tried reformer Pilates in Clitheroe? Our Reformer Foundations intro is your gentle way in: £45 covers three classes, with plenty of guidance as you learn.

Book your spot this week through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
